description: This file defines an Android activity 'CameraPreviewActivity' that manages camera access, displays a camera preview, and handles camera availability errors. It is part of a sample app demonstrating runtime permission management for camera use.

classes.name: CameraPreviewActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays a camera preview using Camera API, handling camera initialization, display orientation and resource release.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes camera and preview view; loads appropriate layout based on camera availability.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases camera resources when activity is paused.

methods.name: getCameraInstance
methods.description: Tries to open camera with specified ID; returns null if not available, showing a toast message.

methods.name: releaseCamera
methods.description: Releases the camera resource if it has been acquired.
